svg.text: From first conversation to monthly results. Seven phases, three gates.
What the client wants and how it is
Form, call, booking, what is excluded
From the website, reviews, ads and
Logo, colours, fonts. Figma only if
Fix tags before any content goes out
Do not publish until both are true
Three to five themes tied to services
Blog, posts, creative text. Lint must
Four posts in one shareable link
You pick the photo, the app renders
Gate before the loop runs on its own
Decide what to change next month
